attractions.name: Mt. Titlis
attractions.description: Iconic Swiss mountain experience with the world's first rotating cable car (Titlis Rotair), Titlis Cliff Walk (Europe's highest suspension bridge), glacier cave, snow tubing, and panoramic views of glaciers and snowy peaks.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. INR 9,000–14,000 per person depending on Swiss Pass discounts

attractions.name: Mount Titlis
attractions.description: Spectacular alpine destination featuring the world's first rotating cable car (Titlis Rotair), glacier cave, Cliff Walk, and panoramic mountain views.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. ₹11,500–14,500 per person including cable car access

attractions.name: Titlis Cliff Walk
attractions.description: Europe's highest suspension bridge offering dramatic glacier views beneath your feet and thrilling alpine scenery.

attractions.name: Titlis Glacier Cave
attractions.description: Glowing blue ice tunnels and intricately carved frozen sculptures inside the glacier, creating a surreal underground world.

transport_options.description: Multi-stage cable car journey from Engelberg valley station to Mount Titlis summit, including the world's first rotating cable car (Titlis Rotair).
transport_options.cost: ~₹8,000–10,000 per person (discount with Swiss Travel Pass)

transport_options.description: The world's first rotating cable car ascending to Mt. Titlis summit with 360° views of glaciers and snowy peaks.
transport_options.cost: Lucerne–Engelberg route covered; cable car section discounted with Swiss Pass. Full ticket approx. INR 9,000–14,000
